summary.text: Bob Stevenson is the Republican candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Abigail Treasure (D).
He won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary over incumbent Trevor Lee.

paragraphs.text: Bob Stevenson graduated from Weber State University with a bachelor's degree in business administration and marketing and attended a master's degree program in distributive education at Utah State University.
As of the 2020 election, his professional experience included teaching, sales and home construction.
In 2020, Stevenson finished second, with 28.6% of the vote, behind Blake Moore (30.9%) in the Republican primary for U.S. House Utah District 1.
